articles.summary: PORTLAND, Ore., July 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Pixelworks, Inc. (NASDAQ: PXLW), a provider of innovative cinematic and enhanced visualization solutions, will release its second quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, after market close.
articles.title: Pixelworks to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 11
